_comment: secrets-manager-bootstrap.json -- inventory of Secrets Manager entries used by Moosewave production tasks. This file is the source of truth for: (a) what to create before first deploy, (b) which environment variable each secret maps to, and (c) recommended rotation cadence. API runtime secrets are referenced by ecs-task-definition.json; the privileged migration-db-dsn is referenced only by ecs-migrator-task-definition.json. Note: both binaries read DATABASE_URL, but they receive different role-scoped credentials.
_naming: Secret names follow postwave/<env>/<purpose>. Slashes are valid in Secrets Manager names and let IAM scope ARNs by prefix. Use the same shape across staging/prod (postwave/staging/..., postwave/prod/...).
_rotation_note: RecommendedRotationDays is operational guidance, not Secrets Manager AutoRotation config. Some secrets (auth pepper, sending KEK) are tied to data at rest; rotating them requires the dual-secret read-then-cutover pattern documented in docs/runbooks/auth-aws.md.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/db-dsn
Secrets.Description: Postgres DSN for the postwave_app role. Format: postgres://postwave_app:<pw>@<rds-endpoint>:5432/postwave?sslmode=require. RDS-managed credentials should rotate the password independently; this secret stores the assembled DSN for the API.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/migration-db-dsn
Secrets.Description: Privileged Postgres DSN used only by the one-shot postwave-db-migrator ECS task. Never inject this into API or sidecar tasks. Build it from the RDS-managed master credential, rotate with that credential, and restrict read access to the ECS execution role.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/auth-hmac-pepper
Secrets.Description: HMAC-SHA256 pepper for auth_sessions.verifier_hash. >=32 random bytes. Rotation: see auth-aws.md (dual-pepper read-with-bake-in; immediate rotate would invalidate every live session).

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/auth-kek
Secrets.Description: Key-encryption-key for auth_totp_secrets.secret_encrypted (envelope-encrypted TOTP seeds). >=32 bytes. Rotating requires re-encrypting every row; treat as a yearly maintenance window task.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/oauth/google
Secrets.Description: Google OAuth 2.0 client secret. Pair with non-secret POSTWAVE_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID env var. Rotate when staff with Google Cloud project access offboard.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/listmonk-webhook
Secrets.Description: HMAC secret Listmonk uses to sign inbound webhooks (events POSTed to /api/internal/listmonk/events). Both ends must hold the same value; rotate by deploying the new secret to Listmonk first, then to the API in a single window.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/postmark-hmac
Secrets.Description: HMAC secret for verifying Postmark feedback-loop webhooks (bounces/complaints) into /api/internal/feedback/postmark. Configured in the Postmark dashboard per server.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/sendgrid-hmac
Secrets.Description: HMAC secret for verifying SendGrid event webhooks into /api/internal/feedback/sendgrid. Configured in the SendGrid Mail Settings panel.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/arf-hmac
Secrets.Description: HMAC secret for ARF (Abuse Reporting Format) feedback-loop submissions. Used by ISP-direct FBL pipelines.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/api-key-pepper
Secrets.Description: HMAC pepper for hashing tenant-scoped API keys (api_keys.token_hash). >=32 bytes. main.go fails fast in prod if unset. Rotation requires re-hashing every API key; coordinate with customers (rolling re-issuance window).

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/consent-cursor-signing-key
Secrets.Description: Dedicated >=32-byte HMAC key for consent-evidence cursor authentication and subject-filter binding. Never reuse auth, API-key, encryption, or PII-fingerprint material. Rotation intentionally invalidates active consent pagination cursors.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/sms-inbox-cursor-key
Secrets.Description: Dedicated >=32-byte key for AES-GCM authenticated encryption of short-lived SMS inbox cursors. Never reuse auth, API-key, consent, encryption, or PII-fingerprint material. Canonical rotation invalidates active cursors; an optional prior key may be injected only for a controlled overlap of at most one 15-minute cursor TTL and must then be removed.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/helpdesk-cursor-key
Secrets.Description: Dedicated >=32-byte key for AES-GCM authenticated encryption of short-lived tenant/query-bound Helpdesk cursors. Never reuse auth, API-key, consent, SMS, encryption, or PII-fingerprint material.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/pii-fingerprint-pepper
Secrets.Description: Dedicated >=32-byte HMAC master pepper for tenant-separated, domain-separated shadow-PII fingerprints. Never reuse auth or API-key peppers. Rotation requires a new POSTWAVE_PII_FINGERPRINT_KEY_VERSION; historical findings retain their original version.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/sending-kek
Secrets.Description: Key-encryption-key for envelope-encrypting per-tenant sending tokens (SMTP, Postmark, SendGrid creds stored in DB). 32 raw bytes. Slack/Discord/Teams integrations also need this -- without it those integrations refuse to start.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/migration-session-kek
Secrets.Description: KEK for sessions persisted by the migration service (cross-platform list-import workflows). >=32 bytes. Independent from sending-kek so a migration-side compromise does not also expose live sender tokens.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/internal-api-token
Secrets.Description: Bearer token shared between the API gateway and internal sidecars (migration, deliverability, voice, automation). Required in production; readiness check fails if unset.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/metrics-token
Secrets.Description: Dedicated high-entropy bearer token used only by the private ADOT collector to scrape each service's /metrics endpoint. Do not reuse the internal API token. Rotate the collector and all five workloads in one controlled deployment.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/redis-url
Secrets.Description: TLS Redis connection URL used by the API distributed auth/rate-limit stores and the automation/sidecar workers. Production startup fails closed when Redis is unreachable.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/portal-jwt
Secrets.Description: HMAC key for short-lived one-time audit portal bootstrap/session JWTs. At least 32 random bytes; independent from API/auth peppers so portal revocation has a separate blast radius.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/anthropic-api-key
Secrets.Description: Provider-issued Anthropic API key for optional production AI features. Omit the feature rather than placing this value in a non-secret task environment.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/gemini-api-key
Secrets.Description: Provider-issued Google Gemini API key required by the production voice and deliverability services.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/campaign-assurance-gemini-api-key
Secrets.Description: Dedicated provider-issued Google Gemini API key injected only into the Campaign Assurance provider-gateway container. Never inject it into the API, assurance worker, model sandbox, image broker, OCR, or scanner containers.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/openai-api-key
Secrets.Description: Provider-issued OpenAI API key required for production semantic voice-fidelity embeddings.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/hcti-user-id
Secrets.Description: HTML/CSS to Image account user ID used by the production cross-client renderer.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/hcti-api-key
Secrets.Description: HTML/CSS to Image API credential required by the production cross-client renderer.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/seedlist-registry-json
Secrets.Description: Inline JSON registry of active seed-list mailboxes. For vendor mode this contains mailbox metadata but no mailbox passwords.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/seedlist-vendor-api-key
Secrets.Description: Bearer credential for the normalized production seed-list vendor/proxy endpoint.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/listmonk-admin-password
Secrets.Description: Rotated Listmonk admin/API password used by internal Moosewave services. Never use the local listmonk/listmonk default.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/dodo-payments-api-key
Secrets.Description: Dodo Payments live business API key used by Moosewave hosted Checkout and Customer Portal session creation.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/dodo-payments-webhook-key
Secrets.Description: Dodo Payments Standard Webhooks signing key (whsec_...) for the live Moosewave billing endpoint.

Secrets.Name: moosewave/prod/dodo-payments-product-launch-monthly
Secrets.Description: Approved live Dodo Payments recurring product ID for Moosewave Launch at USD 39/month.

Secrets.Name: moosewave/prod/dodo-payments-product-growth-monthly
Secrets.Description: Approved live Dodo Payments recurring product ID for Moosewave Growth at USD 99/month.

Secrets.Name: moosewave/prod/dodo-payments-product-scale-monthly
Secrets.Description: Approved live Dodo Payments recurring product ID for Moosewave Scale at USD 349/month.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/migration-stripe-secret-key
Secrets.Description: Dedicated Stripe live restricted key (rk_live_...) used only by packages/migrate/stripeconnect against connected accounts. In Stripe Workbench, grant Subscriptions: Read and Customers: Read only; leave Checkout Sessions, Billing Portal, refunds, payment methods, prices, products, and every write permission disabled. The customer read grant is required because subscription listing expands data.customer.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/migration-mailchimp-client-id
Secrets.Description: Mailchimp OAuth application client ID used only by the migration sidecar. Stored with its companion secret so the complete provider configuration is injected atomically at task start.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/migration-mailchimp-client-secret
Secrets.Description: Mailchimp OAuth application client secret used only by the migration sidecar.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/migration-convertkit-client-id
Secrets.Description: Kit (ConvertKit) OAuth application client ID used only by the migration sidecar. Stored with its companion secret so the complete provider configuration is injected atomically at task start.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/migration-convertkit-client-secret
Secrets.Description: Kit (ConvertKit) OAuth application client secret used only by the migration sidecar.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/cookie-signing
Secrets.Description: Reserved for additional cookie-signing material if/when we issue signed (non-opaque) cookies. Not currently consumed by main.go but pre-provisioned so the IAM grant does not need a redeploy when added.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/ops-db-dsn
Secrets.Description: Postgres DSN for the postwave_ops role (internal ops console). Migration 1700 creates the role NOLOGIN with no base-table access; grant LOGIN out of band with ALTER ROLE postwave_ops LOGIN PASSWORD '<openssl rand -base64 32>' and store the assembled DSN here. Format: postgres://postwave_ops:<pw>@<rds-endpoint>:5432/postwave?sslmode=require. Independently revocable from the postwave_app credential: rotating this one password cuts off the ops console without touching the customer-facing API.

Secrets.Name: postwave/prod/ops-slack-webhook-url
Secrets.Description: Slack incoming-webhook URL for the internal ops console's push channel (alerts, daily digest, push canary). A webhook URL is a bearer credential — anyone holding it can post into the ops channel — so treat it as a secret and rotate it by regenerating the webhook from the Slack app's Incoming Webhooks page.
